# Library fixtures

These FLAC audio files are CC0 audio fixtures for Scarab's integration tests. They
are independently licensed from Scarab's project source and are dedicated to the
public domain under CC0 1.0.

The audio content is unchanged. Only filenames, directory layout, and FLAC
Vorbis-comment metadata (ALBUM, ALBUMARTIST, ARTIST, TITLE, TRACKNUMBER) were
normalized for the purposes of testing. The embedded PNG picture in
`album-two/01-hans-im-schnokeloch.flac` was preserved unchanged.
